name: Objectives, Tasks, Grouping, Execution, Review
foundation_dependencies: LLD-04 WFM immutable source evidence, accepted source projection and source-plan reconciliation handoff
scope: Local Task and WFM Task operational identity
Objective identity and stable MW tracking handle
Objective membership pinned to reviewed Task-plan revisions
derived Objective envelope and aggregate execution/review projections
global strict-overlap grouping and exact regroup proposals
Task execution, cancellation, reviewed outcome and append-only corrections
Objective archive and narrow hard-delete eligibility
not_owned_here: immutable WFM workbook/source observations and source vocabulary -> LLD-04
transaction_boundaries: Timezone parsing/conversion, text validation, broad interval grouping, proposal diff calculation and other expensive preview work occur outside BEGIN IMMEDIATE against stable snapshots.

Every standalone LLD-05 authoritative mutation uses one short LLD-01 UnitOfWork and one command receipt inserted before receipt-FK children; authoritative Task/Objective revisions, plans, membership, locks and lifecycle facts are revalidated inside that UnitOfWork.

Pure preview queries for Objective creation and Task/Objective hard-delete eligibility create no receipt, domain revision, audit event or proposal state; their later commands revalidate the exact preview fingerprint and all safety-critical authority under the writer lock.

LLD-04 WFM proposal acceptance and LLD-03 terminal-RFC cascade call LLD-05 through bounded participant services using the caller's already-open UnitOfWork and command context; LLD-05 never commits, rolls back or creates a competing receipt inside those calls.
Task-plan acceptance and Objective regroup acceptance are separate transactions: changing the current Task plan never silently advances the Objective membership plan pin or envelope.

One accepted regroup proposal is one atomic membership/envelope/supersession mutation; exact affected Task/Objectives are revalidated and the post-write indexed non-overlap guard must pass before commit.

Task execution/outcome corrections append new evidence and rebuild projections atomically without updating prior evidence; Objective review appends only after exact current member outcomes/inclusion fingerprint is revalidated.

Historical Objective acceptance, source-plan-derived historical Task-plan creation when needed, Objective identity allocation and structure-only membership commit atomically and create no execution/outcome/Inventory facts.

RFC terminal-cascade Task/Objective consequences are all-or-nothing with the calling LLD-03 cascade transaction; any stale captured WFM identity/revision, participant failure or INDETERMINATE result aborts the complete outer transaction.
failure_modes: invalid/partial Task intervals remain unscheduled or reject the requested mutation; timestamps are never invented, rounded or inferred from Objective/source chronology
stale Task plans, membership pins, Objective envelopes, locks, regroup fingerprints or reviewed source revisions fail closed and require refreshed preview/review
global regroup acceptance is blocked when recomputation would leave overlapping current Objectives, restructure terminal Objectives, or illegally move protected started work

provider Complete or Plan Cancel never directly creates local execution/outcome; local source-terminal consequence requires its explicit exact review boundary, while historical Complete creates structure only through separate review
competing WFM attempts retain all distinct TK identities; unresolved same-activity overlap is surfaced as conflict rather than collapsed or evaded with overlapping Objectives

whole-Objective cancellation fails when any member has accepted start evidence; loss of the final executable Task from an in-progress Objective derives Incomplete — Awaiting Review rather than Completed/Cancelled
retry fails closed on predecessor/successor uniqueness, cycle, identity reuse or indeterminate cross-domain relationship eligibility
hard deletion fails closed on source provenance, execution/outcome/review/retry/history, protected relationships or any INDETERMINATE dependency; MW and Task identities are never reused
crash/rollback and participant failure points across Task creation/planning/grouping/execution/review/retry/historical structure and RFC cascade are explicit in tests/failure-injection.json
review_evidence: Task/WFM identity, owning-RFC assignment, Local Task relationships and retry lineage remain separate from RFC and source identity owners.
Source WFM plan, accepted operational Task plan, Objective membership-pinned Task plan/envelope and actual execution are distinct authorities.
Global transitive strict-overlap grouping uses deterministic interval-sweep semantics with exact-touch separation and reviewed bridge consolidation rather than pairwise O(n^2) comparison.
Current Task-plan revision may advance independently while Objective membership remains pinned to the exact reviewed plan revision until explicit regroup acceptance.
Objective tracking identity is stable and non-reusable while monthly ordinal remains derived presentation only.

Task execution/outcome and Objective aggregate/review semantics are independently represented; StartSelectedObjectiveTasks is only a Task-execution batch convenience scoped by current Objective membership and creates no Objective start event, timestamp or execution authority.
Provider Complete/Plan Cancel and confirmed RFC-terminal consequences never fabricate Task completion; local termination and historical-structure review are separate governed paths.

Historical provider Complete plus valid accepted source plan may support reviewed Objective structure without fabricating execution, outcome, Device work, spare use or Inventory consequence; exact matching operational plan may be reused, while a different operational plan blocks acceptance.
LLD-04 WFM mutation and LLD-03 terminal-cascade participant contracts use same-UoW/no-nested-commit behavior.
Objective timezone is scheduling-only; ordinary/SLA chronology is not altered by this setting.
Pure previews are explicit read models with query transport and no command receipt/audit/revision side effect; commit commands consume/revalidate their fingerprints separately.
Objective workbench membership transport is deterministic and paged with exact count/continuation; transport paging never becomes authoritative membership for envelope/aggregate/review guards.
V2 retrofit assigns every public route a canonical /api/v1 path, exact request/response contract, LLD-12 auth policy, request bound and stable error surface without shifting domain authority.

Granularity split preserves all authoritative command names, all 48 acceptance scenario IDs, and every original Task/Objective/grouping schema table while turning aggregate files into normative indexes.
Formal Beta LLD Pass 1 and Pass 2 are both PASS; the corrected Pass-2 source passed the strengthened whole-repository gate with zero findings.
design_principle: Task is the independent attempt and execution authority. Objective is a reviewed grouping whose membership pins exact accepted Task-plan revisions; source plans, current operational plans, reviewed Objective membership/envelope and actual execution remain separate so no import, plan edit, clock passage or aggregate action can silently fabricate regrouping or execution.
